claimant_lives_in_uk.description: Whether the claimant lives in the UK.

children.description: A list of children the claimant is claiming for.

lives_with_claimant.description: Whether the child lives with the claimant.

in_approved_education.description: Whether the child is in approved education or training (e.g. A-levels, GCSEs, NVQ up to level 3). Only relevant for children aged 16-19.

in_extension_period.description: Whether the child (aged 16 or 17) has left education and registered with a government-sponsored careers service or the armed forces (qualifying for a 20-week extension).

upkeep_per_week.description: The amount in £ per week the claimant contributes towards the child's upkeep (food, clothes, pocket money, etc.). Only relevant if the child does not live with the claimant.

another_claimant_has_priority.description: Whether another person who also lives with the child has priority for claiming Child Benefit.

another_claimant_lives_with_child.description: Whether someone who lives with the child is already claiming Child Benefit for them.

care_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in local authority care.

care_home_24h_per_week.description: Whether the child spends at least 24 hours per week at home while in local authority care.

hospital_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in hospital or residential accommodation.

claimant_spends_on_child.description: Whether the claimant regularly spends money on the child (e.g. food, clothes, books) while the child is in hospital or residential accommodation.

is_fostered.description: Whether the child is fostered by the claimant.

council_pays_for_child.description: Whether the local council pays towards the child's accommodation or maintenance.

works_24_plus_hours.description: Whether the child works 24 or more hours per week in paid employment.

started_apprenticeship_in_england.description: Whether the child has started an apprenticeship in England.

receives_qualifying_benefits.description: Whether the child receives qualifying benefits in their own right, such as Universal Credit or Employment and Support Allowance.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine your eligibility for Child Benefit.

To get started, could you please tell me: **How many children are you inquiring about, and what are their names?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Oh hi, thanks for helping me with this! I'm asking about my daughter Alex. She's 8 years old and lives at home with me here in Manchester.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that information! It's great to meet you, and I'm happy to help assess your eligibility for Child Benefit for Alex.

To determine eligibility, I need to gather a bit more information about your circumstances.

**First, could you tell me: Are you a British citizen, or do you have settled status or pre-settled status under the UK's immigration system?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I'm a British citizen. I was born and raised here in the UK.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Excellent, thank you for confirming that. That's helpful information.

**Next, could you tell me: Are you currently residing in the UK, and have you been living here continuously?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I live in Manchester and I've been living here continuously. Haven't gone anywhere!

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Great, thank you for that confirmation. That's very helpful.

**Now, could you tell me: Is Alex in full-time education or training, or does she have any other circumstances I should know about (such as being in care or having any disabilities)?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: No, nothing like that. She's just 8, so she's at primary school doing normal classes for her age. Nothing unusual - she's just a regular kid living at home with me.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Perfect, thank you for that information. That's all clear.

**One more question: Are there any other children living with you or that you're responsible for, apart from Alex?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: No, it's just Alex. She's my only child.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for confirming that. I now have all the information I need to assess your eligibility for Child Benefit for Alex.

Let me review your circumstances against the eligibility criteria:

- You are a British citizen ✓
- You are residing in the UK continuously ✓
- Alex is 8 years old and living with you ✓
- Alex is in full-time education (primary school) ✓
- There are no other complications or circumstances that would affect eligibility ✓

Based on this information, you meet all the requirements for Child Benefit for Alex.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Congratulations! **You are eligible for Child Benefit for Alex.**

You can now proceed to claim Child Benefit through the appropriate channels. If you have any other questions about your eligibility or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to ask!
